body:
Fixes #27632

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`validating-metadata.mdx` 的 `GET /api/v1/meta/diagnostics` 一节补一句：该路由只认 `type`、`severity`、`package` 三个参数名，其他参数名(如 `?typ=view`)回 400 `INVALID_REQUEST`,不再悄悄回全量扫描。
- 为什么改:#27913 已让路由拒收未知参数名，文档还没写;读文档的 AI 和 CI 作者会以为拼错参数名只是被忽略。
- 风险与回滚：仅文档，一个文件、一段(+7 / -3);回滚即 revert 本 PR,不影响任何发布包。
- 先看:`content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` diagnostics 一节表格下方第一段。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`,预期只见表格下方那一段改写，多出参数名拒收与先后顺序两句。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The paragraph below the `GET /api/v1/meta/diagnostics` query table in `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` now states the refusal PR #27913 added. Each clause is written from the code on `origin/main` (`fece78120c`, which contains #27913's merge `9cd54faae5`):

- The route accepts exactly three parameter names: `META_DIAGNOSTICS_PARAMS = ['type', 'severity', 'package']` in `packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts`. There is no wider declared set.
- Any other name (`?typ=view`, `?packageId=…`) is refused with `400 INVALID_REQUEST`, even when its value is empty. The handler asks `unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage` (`packages/rest/src/query-allowlist.ts`) and throws `diagnosticsRefusal`. `isDiagnosticsRefusal` writes it in the nested `{ error: { code, message } }` envelope. The message names the unknown parameter and the supported set (`Supported parameters: package, severity, type.`). The route no longer answers the full sweep.
- The name check runs before `refuseRepeatedQueryParams`, so an unknown name beside a repeated known one answers `INVALID_REQUEST`. A repeated known parameter alone still answers `VALIDATION_ERROR`.

The page's existing sentence "Every refusal answers in the nested envelope" now covers the new refusal as well, because the new text sits before it.

## Tests

Docs only, so there is no test to run. The route's own pins in `packages/rest/src/rest-meta-diagnostics-unknown-params.test.ts` (unchanged, in the `[#27633]` describe block) back each new clause: `?typ=view` refused with the supported set in the message, `?packageId=` refused, an unknown name with an empty value refused, an unknown name outranking a repeated one, and the three known names together answering 200.

## Acceptance notes

- No finding filed.
- Card comment 6514340216 says the closed set is "`type`, `severity`, `package`, and the rest of the declared set". The code declares exactly those three, so the page names three.
